title.vi: Pipeline, tinh chỉnh siêu tham số và rò rỉ dữ liệu
title.en: Pipelines, hyperparameter tuning and data leakage

files.name: main.py
files.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)

from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, cross_val_score

pipe = Pipeline([("scale", StandardScaler()), ("knn", KNeighborsClassifier())])
print(cross_val_score(pipe, X_train, y_train, cv=5).mean().round(3))

grid = GridSearchCV(pipe, {"knn__n_neighbors": [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11]}, cv=5)
grid.fit(X_train, y_train)
print(grid.best_params_, round(grid.best_score_, 3))
print("test:", round(grid.score(X_test, y_test), 3))

from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score

pipe = Pipeline([("scale", StandardScaler()), ("clf", LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))])
cv_mean = cross_val_score(pipe, X_train, y_train, cv=5).mean()
print(round(cv_mean, 3))
